reason: The owner's redirect made Fleet the low-cost engineering lab and the first real device-management evidence source. The adapter is proven against fixtures and was proven once against a real Fleet 4.89.2 (proof:live-fleet, 30 assertions) — but never since the DeviceManagementEvidence contract and the launch seam landed. This runs the live lane against a real Fleet so the source-agnostic claim is backed by a real source, not only by fixtures that agree with themselves.
notes: `live-lanes` skips loudly by name for any lane whose credentials are unset — a skip is recorded as a skip, never as a pass. Fleet is the one that matters here; Wazuh/Keycloak/Traccar skipping is fine.
Fleet Free runs in Docker: docs/FLEET_LIVE_INTEGRATION.md has the compose path. The image is amd64-only and Docker Desktop emulates it on Apple Silicon.
`docker` verifies the production stack builds and smoke-tests on the Mac — the half CI cannot reach because it needs a container engine.
This is the request to run SECOND, after the post-merge baseline is green. A live-source failure is only interpretable against a known-good deterministic baseline.
